performance.threshold: 适配层零轮询；服务快照订阅模式不变（不新增定时器）
performance.validation: 代码审查 + smoke 断言（无新增 setInterval/poll）

reliability.threshold: 旧 dsh（connection.api 存在）与新 dsh（remote.* 存在）双表面特性检测，任一可用即工作；两者皆缺 → 降级提示不崩溃
reliability.validation: smoke 断言两分支 + TypeError 防护（设置页 effect 守卫）

security.threshold: 不改 HTTP API 鉴权面；settings 写入仍走宿主 RPC；无新增网络端点
security.validation: 代码审查（diff 范围核对）

accessibility.threshold: 错误态可读（设置页/对话框失败显示文字而非白屏）

ux.threshold: 三症状消失；既有交互语义不变（反选关闭、脏稿守卫、豁免令牌）
ux.validation: 实机验证（用户重启 dsh 后）+ 探针行为断言

maintainability.threshold: API 访问收口单一适配层（一处特性检测）；调用面不改语义签名（{result} 包装在适配层归一）

vertical_slice.user_visible_slice: 工作区对话框从「API 不可用」变为可用列表并可切换（最小切片）；设置页从白屏变为可读写表单；跨工作区点会话工作台自动退出。
vertical_slice.demo_path: 实机 http://127.0.0.1:3080 + 探针脚本输出
vertical_slice.scope_guard: 仅 lib/client.js + package.json（manifest inject 包表）+ test/smoke.mjs 断言 + CHANGELOG/README 同步；禁触 lib/index.js 服务端与视觉样式
vertical_slice.rollback_plan: git revert 单 commit；旧表面回退分支保留（connection.api 存在时走旧路径），最坏退化为修复前行为

interruption_policy.mode: critical-only: default execute routine reversible work and record assumptions when needed
critical_triggers: Ask the user when product intent is unclear.
Ask the user when acceptance standard or done criteria are unclear.
Ask the user before irreversible, release, risk acceptance, external dependency, or mode change decisions.
auto_execute: Run routine execution, local validation, focused code edits, and governance record updates when scope is known and reversible.
Commit and push normal single-task changes when validation, evidence, and review gates are satisfied.

interruption_policy.interruption_budget: At most one user interruption per work unit unless a new critical trigger appears.
